methods.text_en: Layer existing glass, frames or reflections while preserving character relationships.
methods.text_zh: 借已有玻璃、门框或反射分层，保持原人物关系。

methods.text_en: When permitted, move laterally or observe closely while preserving waiting and motion continuity.
methods.text_zh: 允许时缓慢横移或近距离观察，维持等待与动作连续。
